Hi Sofia / Carlos,

As we approach the July renewal window (account team notes the subscription anniversary on 2026-10-15), I wanted to align on two parallel items so we can avoid last-minute gating:

1) SOC 2 re-attestation / evidence handoff — Helix’s renewal requires a fresh SOC 2-scope confirmation. Our compliance team will need the updated evidence index and log-retention window to complete the re-attestation. I attached a short renewal-playbook that summarizes what we typically provide and the timeline we’ve used with similar customers.
2) Capacity uplift & term — You mentioned traffic growth; we have a 30% capacity uplift offer that pairs well with a longer term. I can propose an 18-month term with stepped pricing if you’re open.

Requested next steps:
- Can you confirm the internal auditor contact and whether Helix requires a 90 vs 180 day log retention window?
- Please share any procurement timelines (DocuSign/PO cadence).
- If helpful, we can set a 30-minute evidence review with our security lead this week.

Attachments: renewal-playbook-v1.pdf

Thanks — happy to coordinate the handoff.

Best,
